title: Writing done after the session silently ends (~44 min) is lost; the app keeps looking signed in for ~6 more minutes
steps: Sign in and keep working without a pause: handwriting on the board, open a worksheet / video / image and write on them, play the video. Keep going past 44 minutes.
expected: Everything written is saved; the teacher is warned before the session ends.
actual: Token renewals succeed every 4 min until 39:51; the next (due ~43:50) never happens. From 43:58 the app slows (video play/pause takes 30 s) but still looks signed in and accepts the pen. The sign-out shows only at 49:52. 417 strokes written on the board, 390 saved: the 27 strokes written after minute 44 are lost. No warning at any point.

title: The desktop client crashes ("Target crashed") when it opens a board of about 8,400+ strokes, and again at every sign-in while that board is the last topic
steps: Open a topic whose board holds about 8,400 strokes or more (12A Physics 1.7, 1.8, 1.9; 7A Value Education 1.1).
actual: The client crashes; with that topic as the last one, it crashes again at every sign-in. A board of 5,190 strokes opens fine. Moving the account to a light topic from a browser is the only way out.

title: While the server is down (e.g. a new build being deployed) the pen strokes join into long scribbles, nothing is saved, and no message is shown
steps: Write on the board while the server restarts.
expected: A message that saving is not possible; writing kept and saved when the server is back; strokes drawn normally.
actual: Strokes joined into long straight-line scribbles on screen; about 5 lines written during the outage were never saved; no message.
